name: The Good News and The Bad News

meta.wiki: The Good News and The Bad News

summary: Narain Soothfancy has read the ledger and found good news and bad. He is nearly certain he can build the arcanite buoy you specified, but needs arcanite, elementium ore, and fine gems. The chicken, the goggles, and the second Draconic For Dummies book must all be done first.

sections.title: Good News, Bad News
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy studies the ledger and murmurs under his breath. He is ninety-nine percent sure he can build the arcanite buoy to your specifications. The materials are the bad news. He asks for twenty arcanite bars, ten elementium ore, ten Azerothian diamonds, and ten blue sapphires. Bring them, and he will craft the buoy.

sections.title: Narain's Warning
sections.body: When you bring the materials, Narain says a deal is a deal. He hopes you know what you are getting into. To him, gathering so much is a great deal of bother just to go fishing.

faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy offers it after the chicken, the Scrying Goggles, and the second Draconic For Dummies book are all done.
Narain requires twenty arcanite bars, ten elementium ore, ten Azerothian diamonds, and ten blue sapphires.

faq.q: What is Narain building with these materials?
faq.answer: Narain is building an arcanite buoy. He is ninety-nine percent sure it will work to your specifications.
Return to Narain comes before this. The goggles and the second Draconic For Dummies book must also be finished.
